RendererSwitchRequest.title: RendererSwitchRequest
RendererSwitchRequest.description: One renderer switch request: source session, primary target renderer, expected world digest and tenant (continuity claims), target session id, ordered fallback chain, and virtual time.

RendererFabricProtocolVersion.title: RendererFabricProtocolVersion
RendererFabricProtocolVersion.description: Exact renderer-fabric protocol version admitted by this release ("1.0.0").

SwitchId.title: SwitchId
SwitchId.description: Renderer switch identifier: "sw-" followed by a lowercase slug.

FabricSessionId.title: FabricSessionId
FabricSessionId.description: Renderer fabric-session identifier: "fx-" followed by a lowercase slug (ephemeral, non-authoritative).

RendererId.title: RendererId
RendererId.description: Renderer-descriptor identifier: "rr-" followed by a lowercase slug (never a vendor product).

VirtualTimeMs.title: VirtualTimeMs
VirtualTimeMs.description: Virtual time in non-negative integer milliseconds (mirrored shared primitive; canonical home @epoch/experience-runtime).
